title: Finite evaluation of the actual tower tensor transpose and oriented composite
statement: Let ell be prime, E a finite extension of Q_ell, f=j followed by p a smooth open/proper factorized morphism of separated finite-type schemes over the finite-field datum, and use the actual ordinary tower operations, the full constructible finite-Tor subcategories and compact-support adjunction with its normalized finite levels. Assume the tensor sources belong to the full subcategory and each specified projection is invertible. Fix a coefficient level n+1, a coefficient-unit origin isomorphism with its normalization equation, and an orientation of the ordered Tate line with its finite diagonal normalization and WordComparison. Fix the normalized tensor and geometric level coordinates. The specified tensorWord comparison is invertible. The evaluated originalComposite is the inverse finite adjunction Hom equivalence of intrinsicTheta. The specified tensorMate has WordComparison with finiteTheta, and the oriented composite gamma has WordComparison with the finite smooth purity gamma. These are only the per-level evaluation conclusions; no naturality in the tower input is asserted. The tensor, pullback, realization, unit and orientation comparisons are the fixed normalized comparisons of the cited tower, finite purity and level-word definitions.

source.place: (2), evaluation of the inverse-projection/counit composite, its transpose and the oriented composite

proof.text: Exact evaluation preserves composites and inverses. The normalized tensor, pullback and compact-support comparisons identify tensorWord with the evaluated tensor source. The right-adjoint and unit comparisons identify dualizingWord with the evaluated exceptional unit. Each factor is invertible, so tensorWord.comparison is invertible. Evaluate originalComposite: the support and realization comparisons cancel; the level counit equation and the specified projection comparison identify the remaining factors with the finite inverse-projection/counit composite. Symmetry naturality converts its right-unitor order to the left-unitor order in the finite tensor-duality map. Transport by the full inclusions gives the asserted inverse finite Hom-equivalence equation for intrinsicTheta.

source.place: (2), evaluation of the inverse-projection/counit composite, its transpose and the oriented composite

proof.text: Evaluate the actual adjunction transpose using the unit comparison of the tower gluing data. The preceding counit equation and the finite triangle identity give the WordComparison with finiteTheta, the specified finite canonical tensor map. All arrows are transported through the normalized full-subcategory comparisons, so this step does not infer equality from faithfulness of evaluation.

source.place: (2), evaluation of the inverse-projection/counit composite, its transpose and the oriented composite

proof.text: Tensor the supplied orientation WordComparison with the normalized pullback word. Compose its square with the WordComparison for the transpose. The unit normalization equation identifies the dualizing endpoint, and the orientation hypothesis identifies the finite orientation with alpha.inv. The etale composite is the finite smooth-purity gamma by definition, and the tower composite is gamma by definition. This gives the last WordComparison.
